reasons.claim: The isnad runs from Hannad through Abda ibn Sulayman and Abd al-Malik ibn Abi Sulayman to Sa'id ibn Jubayr.
reasons.quote: حدثنا هناد، حدثنا عبدة بن سليمان، عن عبد الملك بن أبي سليمان، عن سعيد بن جبير،

reasons.claim: Sa'id ibn Jubayr goes to Abd Allah ibn Umar and asks him, and Abd Allah ibn Umar answers with the report, making him the last link.
reasons.quote: فقمت مكاني إلى منزل عبد الله بن عمر

reasons.claim: The closing note about other Companions in the chapter is a variant remark rather than a route of this report.
reasons.quote: قال وفي الباب عن سهل بن سعد وابن عباس وابن مسعود وحذيفة

reasons.claim: The chain branches at Shu'ba into three co-transmitters who all heard Abu Wa'il from Hudhayfa.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمود بن غيلان، حدثنا أبو داود، أنبأنا شعبة، عن الأعمش، وحماد، وعاصم بن بهدلة، سمعوا أبا وائل، عن حذيفة،

reasons.claim: Umar is part of the dialogue scene while Hudhayfa is the narrator who answers, so Hudhayfa is the last link.
reasons.quote: قال قال عمر أيكم يحفظ ما قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في الفتنة فقال حذيفة أنا

reasons.claim: The closing mention of Hammad's version is treated as a variant-wording remark rather than a separate route, leaving the three agreed routes intact.
reasons.quote: قال أبو وائل في حديث حماد فقلت لمسروق سل حذيفة عن الباب فسأله فقال عمر

reviews.uncertainty_note: The closing addendum in Hammad's narration could alternatively be read as a second saying transmitted through Masruq from Hudhayfa.

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly through Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', Shu'ba, Abd Rabbih ibn Sa'id, and Abu Salama.
reasons.quote: حدثنا سعيد بن الربيع، حدثنا شعبة، عن عبد ربه بن سعيد، قال سمعت أبا سلمة،

reasons.claim: Abu Salama explicitly hears Abu Qatada, who hears the Prophet, so Abu Qatada is the last link and the Prophet is not a link.
reasons.quote: حتى سمعت أبا قتادة يقول وأنا كنت لأرى الرؤيا تمرضني، حتى سمعت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول

reasons.claim: The opening isnad runs through Musa, Hammam, Yahya, and Abu Salama.
reasons.quote: حدثنا موسى، قال حدثنا همام، عن يحيى، عن أبي سلمة،

reasons.claim: Abu Salama goes to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and asks him to narrate what he heard from the Prophet, making Abu Sa'id al-Khudri the last link.
reasons.quote: قال انطلقت إلى أبي سعيد الخدري

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh to his named uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, followed by an unnamed gap phrase and Umar ibn Aban al-Kalbi.
reasons.quote: حدّثني محمّد بن عليّ ماجيلويه، عن عمّه محمّد بن أبي القاسم بإسناد يرفعه، عن عمر بن أبان الكلبي

reasons.claim: Abu Abd Allah is named as the speaker after the chain and is therefore the last link.
reasons.quote: قال: قال أبو عبد الله عليه السلام:

reasons.claim: The chain branches at the two co-transmitters Ali ibn Abbas and Abd al-Salam ibn Harb who transmit jointly.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَ عَبْدِ السَّلَامِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ جَمِيعاً

reasons.claim: An unnamed transmitter stands between the co-transmitters and Bakr ibn Abd Allah al-Muzani, and the chain ends at Imran ibn al-Husayn who relays the Prophet's words.
reasons.quote: قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَنْ سَمِعَ بَكْرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيَّ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (ص)

reviews.question: al-Faqih's statements of the compiler's routes to a source («طرق») with no saying

reasons.claim: The report is a statement of the compiler's route to al-Fadl ibn Abi Qurra al-Samandi with no saying; if such route statements are kept as chains, the readers' linear route from the compiler's father to al-Fadl is right, and if excluded it would be no_chain.
reasons.quote: فقد رويته عن أبي- رحمه اللّه- عن عليّ بن الحسين السعدآباديّ، عن أحمد بن أبي عبد اللّه البرقيّ، عن شريف بن سابق التفليسيّ، عن الفضل بن أبي قرّة السّمنديّ‌.

reviews.question: a first-person narrative with an unnamed speaker or implicit transmission

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly from the compiler's father through Sa'd ibn Abd Allah, Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, his named brother al-Hasan, and Zur'a ibn Muhammad al-Hadrami to Sama'a ibn Mihran.
reasons.quote: أَبِی ره قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِیسَی عَنِ الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ سَعِیدٍ عَنْ أَخِیهِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَهَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَضْرَمِیِّ عَنْ سَمَاعَهَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ

reasons.claim: Sama'a refers to the speaker only by a pronoun with no previous report supplied, so the structure up to Sama'a is right whether or not an unnamed pronoun speaker is later ruled to add a link.
reasons.quote: قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ یَقُولُ

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly from Muhammad ibn Muqatil Abu al-Hasan through Abd Allah, Hisham ibn Urwa, and his father to A'isha.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن مقاتل أبو الحسن، أخبرنا عبد الله، أخبرنا هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة،

reasons.claim: Abu Bakr is the subject whose practice A'isha describes rather than a transmitter link.
reasons.quote: أن أبا بكر  رضى الله عنه  لم يكن يحنث في يمين قط،

reasons.claim: The report introduces a saying with no transmitter and no named speaker, so it has no isnad.
reasons.quote: وَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ قَالَ:
